props.text: Everything you need to know before getting started.

items.question: How long does a typical AI project take?
items.answer: Most focused automation and AI assistant projects go from discovery to production in 3 to 6 weeks. Larger custom model deployments typically take 6 to 10 weeks with weekly milestones.

items.question: Do we need a large technical team to work with you?
items.answer: Not at all. We handle architecture, development, integration, and deployment end-to-end, and train your team so anyone can operate the system confidently.

items.question: How do you keep our company data secure and private?
items.answer: Your data never trains public models. We deploy within private cloud environments or enterprise APIs with strict encryption, role-based access, and audit logging.

items.question: Can you integrate with the tools we already use?
items.answer: Yes — we integrate natively with Slack, HubSpot, Salesforce, Notion, Linear, Zendesk, Postgres, and custom internal APIs.

items.question: What happens after our AI solution is launched?
items.answer: We provide ongoing monitoring, performance tuning, and support packages to ensure your workflows continue delivering measurable ROI as your business grows.
